отдыхать.gloss: to rest, to relax, to vacation

meanings.en: to rest, to relax, to vacation
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (root 'дыхать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to rest', forming an aspectual pair with 'отдохнуть'.

examples.trans: Guys, tonight we are celebrating!

examples.text: Вы отдыхайте, а мы сами поедем.
examples.trans: You rest, and we'll go ourselves.
Everything is great, get some rest!

meanings.note: Russian perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to take', forming an aspectual pair with 'брать'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

examples.trans: I will put you on half-time pay.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronoun ('I') that declines for case depending on its grammatical function in the sentence.

examples.text: Женщина, не отвлекай, я сейчас проигрываю!

examples.text: Макс, я же тебя просила починить.

examples.text: Я потом куплю новую и прикручу.

examples.trans: Congratulations, that is great!
